content: The Sims 4 has received a steady stream of content since it launched 12 years ago. However, 2026 has been particularly dry. The last major expansion, Royalty & Legacy, was released in February, and aside from kits, the game hasn't received much content this year. This may be because of the team's focus on Project Renee (which may be on hold) or because of internal matters related to Electronic Arts' private-equity buyout.
